title: 13 Best Herbal Teas For Bee Sting
description: Calendula officinalis teas have been traditionally used to treat bee sting ailments due to their anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and soothing properties. The bioactive constituents, such as triterpenoid saponins, flavonoids, and carotenoids, help to reduce swelling, ease pain, and promote wound healing by inhibiting the production of pro-inflammatory enzymes.
